items.title: Private Hospitals See Rise In Dengue Fever Admissions
items.summary: Admissions to private hospitals for dengue fever have jumped this year, similar to public hospitals. APHM advises the public to seek early consultation for high fever, severe headache, joint/muscle pain, or rash, to prevent serious dengue complications. items.title: Over 6,200 Medical Officers Quit From 2021 To 2025: Dzulkefly
items.summary: 6,212 medical officers quit in 5 years from 2021 to 2025, comprising 4,380 contract and 1,832 permanent. Although contract MO resignations have been dropping annually from 2023, resignations of permanent MOs rose every year from 238 in 2021 to 498 in 2025.
